signature: SUBROUTINE DLAED5( I, D, Z, DELTA, RHO, DLAM )

params.name: i
params.reference: The index of the eigenvalue to be computed. $I = 1$ or $I = 2$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The original eigenvalues. We assume $D(1) < D(2)$.

params.name: z
params.reference: The components of the updating vector.

params.name: DELTA
params.reference: The vector `DELTA` contains the information necessary to construct the eigenvectors.

params.name: rho
params.reference: The scalar in the symmetric updating formula.

params.name: dlam
params.reference: The computed lambda\_I, the I-th updated eigenvalue.
